name: patient_is_resident_physician_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently a resident physician.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently a resident physician.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not a resident physician.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently a resident physician.

when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not provide care to adult patients.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently provides care to adult patients.
